column1: # Command per run, in a clone at 31c07e5 with origin/main pinned to 1507ade: bash gates/fastgate-drive.sh unfixed > <log> 2>&1
# Every detailed log was kept (scratchpad t63/logs/unfixed-<run>.log, not committed: ~68 lines each, the summary below carries the verdict lines).

# Runs 17 and 18 overlapped a disk-full window (0 MB free from before 20:32:49Z to about 20:35:30Z, caused by the pipefail probe leak fixed at 12a8665), so both are EXCLUDED and named here; run 18 read H1 FAIL inside that window, run 17 did not. r1-r4 replace them.

# RUN 18 IS NOT UNEXPLAINED: its log prints, for H3-H7, H9 and H14, "FULL SUITE REQUIRED. The stamp-only controls could not be BUILT or RUN", and H1/H2 "FAST GATE RED" - the builds failed while the disk was full. That is the same failed-set SHAPE as the flake this job was filed on (H1 H3 H4 ...), so a transient build failure is now the leading candidate for that flake. It is a candidate, not a reproduction.
